title: Account security
description: How you sign in to Leafdesk. These settings are for your account and apply in every workspace.
connectedAppsNote: Apps you connected over MCP keep their access when you change these settings; they use their own tokens. Disconnect them under Connected apps.

errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.codeRequired: Enter a code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.challengeExpired: This sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes on this account. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.signInAgain: For your security, sign out and sign in again before adding a passkey.
errors.passkeyExists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
errors.passkeyUnknown: This passkey isn't registered here. It may have been removed.
errors.passkeyFailed: The passkey couldn't be verified. Try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

twoFactor.heading: Two-step verification
twoFactor.headingDescription: After your password (or GitHub or Google), signing in also asks for a code from an app on your phone.
twoFactor.title: Authenticator app
twoFactor.on: On. Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.off: Off. Use an app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoFactor.intro: You'll scan a QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.codesIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once without your phone. You won't see them again.
twoFactor.disableBody: Signing in will no longer ask for a code, and your recovery codes stop working. Workspaces that require two-step verification will ask you to set it up again.
twoFactor.disableCodeLabel: Code from your app, or a recovery code

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: Sign in with one when you don't have your phone. Each code works once.
recoveryCodes.regenerateBody: Your current recovery codes stop working and you get ten new ones.
recoveryCodes.newCodes: Your new recovery codes. Keep them somewhere safe; you won't see them again.
recoveryCodes.fileHeading: Leafdesk recovery codes. Each code signs you in once.

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.headingDescription: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. A passkey sign-in counts as two-step verification.
passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove the passkey "{name}"? You can't sign in with it any more.
passkeys.description: Your browser or password manager saves it on this device.

gate.title: {workspace} requires two-step verification
gate.body: An owner of this workspace asks everyone to use a second step when signing in. Set up an authenticator app, or use a passkey, to continue.

ssoGate.title: {workspace} requires single sign-on
ssoGate.body: Members of this workspace sign in through their organization's identity provider. Continue with it to open the workspace.

networkGate.title: {workspace} only allows sign-in from approved networks
networkGate.body: The owners of this workspace let people open it only from approved networks, such as the office or a VPN, and this connection doesn't come from one of them. Connect from an approved network and try again.
networkGate.askOwner: If you should be able to open it from here, ask an owner of the workspace to add this address.
